headline: Building scalable digital experiences across web, mobile & AI.
heroSummary: Senior full-stack engineer, 8+ years. I build across the whole stack: eight Angular applications and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3 front ends on the web, six Flutter apps on mobile — two of them published consumer apps — and Node.js, Express and MongoDB behind both, with production OpenAI features in the last two years.

specialisations.detail: Angular · Vue 3 · Nuxt 3 SSR · TypeScript · Ionic
Flutter · Dart · offline-first · native Kotlin & Swift
OpenAI API · extraction · vision OCR · transcription

highlightsNote: Every figure above is counted from git history. No estimated or percentage claims appear on this site.

about.heading: Web — Angular is my core framework
body: Eight applications and roughly 2,400 commits between 2020 and 2025: EnBuilder, a builder sales and inventory platform where I authored about 80% of 2,075 commits; EnServicePortal, an offline-first construction defect app of ~22,300 lines where I wrote 170 of 179 commits; the EnBuilder purchaser portal, with canvas layout customisation and parking and locker allocation from live inventory; the EnCharity donor and admin portals; and the Shoplocally marketplace applications. Three ship as hybrid mobile apps through Ionic and Capacitor.
More recently, Vue 3 and Nuxt 3: a real-estate CRM where I hold ~61% of 616 commits, and a multi-tenant server-rendered website engine that serves every tenant site from one application.

about.heading: Mobile — six Flutter apps
body: A ~92,000-line CRM I created and authored — 182 of 189 Dart files, 20 feature modules, with native Kotlin and Swift over platform channels. Two published consumer apps for an Australian home-food marketplace as the sole mobile developer. A background-GPS mileage tracker with offline SQLite sync, an open-house kiosk, and a builder purchaser portal.

about.heading: Backend and integrations throughout
body: Node.js, Express and MongoDB microservices; Google Workspace OAuth with two-way Calendar, Tasks, Gmail and Contacts sync; Facebook and Instagram Graph publishing with long-lived token refresh; Stripe, PayPal and PayU payments; and Canadian anti-spam consent enforced at the data layer. Since 2024 I have shipped production AI features on the OpenAI API — structured extraction, vision OCR, document parsing and transcription workflows.

about.heading: Leadership
body: At NeoSoft Technologies I served as associate team lead for eight developers in 2021–2022, running sprint delivery, code review and technical risk assessment. Since then my leadership has been technical rather than managerial: primary author of ten repositories, author of the architecture and implementation guides my teams worked from, and owner of release and QA for the mobile products.

howIWork.title: Offline-first by instinct
howIWork.body: PouchDB in Angular, Hive and SQLite in Flutter — local-write-first, idempotency keys, visible failure states.

howIWork.title: Integrations are where products break
howIWork.body: Token lifecycles, two-way sync and conflict-safe upserts get my attention before features do.

howIWork.title: AI needs engineering around it
howIWork.body: Structured output, duplicate detection, user confirmation before anything is written, and cancellable long-running requests.

howIWork.title: Documented quality
howIWork.body: A 36-case end-to-end QA report, a 48-finding audit and a 21-case device plan — all written by me, not generated.
